title: Build a directed graph in Rust with BFS traversal and path detection
description: Greenfield Rust task: implement a directed Graph backed by a HashMap adjacency list with add_edge, neighbors, bfs_order (BFS node visit order), and has_path (reachability check via BFS).

required_artifacts: Graph backed by HashMap<usize, Vec<usize>> adjacency list
add_edge adds directed edge and ensures both endpoints exist in adj
neighbors returns empty slice for unknown nodes
bfs_order visits neighbors in sorted order for determinism
has_path returns true for self-loops and multi-hop paths; respects direction
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
